result.instructions:
This server controls the illusion game engine editor. Every tool is an editor command.
Workflow: discover (editor_list_commands, editor_describe, scene_tree, component_types), then create (entity_create with Components, component_set, hierarchy_set_parent, transform_set; editor_batch runs several steps as one undo step), save (scene_save), and verify (scene_tree, entity_get, scene_info).
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Angles are radians or {"deg": n}; transform tools also take {"euler": [x, y, z]} in degrees. Quaternions are [x, y, z, w]; colours are linear [r, g, b] or "#rrggbb"; 64-bit integers are decimal strings; asset fields are paths such as "builtin:/mesh/cube".
Entity references: a 16-hex id, a path of names ("/Game/Board"), "name:Board" or "$selection". Results name entities as {id, name, path}.
Mutating tools take dryRun to validate without applying. A failed call returns isError with a code, a kind, the JSON Pointer of the bad parameter, a hint and suggestions. history_undo with {"scope": "mine"} undoes only your own steps.
Read illusion://guide for details and illusion://commands for every command.

prompts.title: Add a Component type

content.text:
Create a new game called "Tetris" with the illusion editor: falling blocks

1. Read illusion://guide for units and entity references.
2. Create the project with project_create (template "3d-starter"), or open one with project_open.
3. Build the scene with entity_create (with Components), hierarchy_set_parent and transform_set; group related steps with editor_batch.
4. Save it with scene_save.
5. Verify it with scene_tree, entity_get and scene_info, and fix what differs.
